legenda: Rivers and Harbors Act of 1896: up to $2.9 million; a board of five decides.
credito_tela: Source: U.S. Statutes at Large, vol. 29, 1896 · Source: Senate Document 18, 1897
nota: Dólares correntes de 1896. O teto é dos contratos do porto escolhido (mais US$ 50 mil para a junta). A junta: um oficial da Marinha, um do Coast and Geodetic Survey e três engenheiros civis.
narracao: In June 1896, Congress passed a rivers and harbors law. A House bill would have put the money at Santa Monica; the law that passed handed the choice to a board of five, whose majority vote would be final as to the location. On March 1, 1897, that board reported: "this Board reports in favor of San Pedro."
